findings: I ran `node --test tests/web-render-finish.test.js` on the final tree. All 16 tests pass (16 pass, 0 fail, 0 skipped). Round 1 had 9 pass and 7 fail, and those failures came from the missing builder output. The tests themselves are unchanged in substance.

I ran `npm test`. The result is 212 pass and 1 fail, and the one failure is `not ok 98 - S11: when reviewer-design has reviewed, it addresses and clears all four images against design/reference/`. That is the single pre-existing design v4 S11 failure the work order itemizes. Nothing else fails, and the builder did not absorb the failure or edit evidence to hide it.

The builder edited the tests, within what S10 permits. In `tests/web-render-finish.test.js` the only change is `SETUP_COMMIT` moving from `4de668a` to `62f98b3`. In `tests/take-apart.test.js` the baseline constant moved the same way, and the scope allowlist was re-pointed at the wo-gh-14 paths. S10 allows re-basing a scope or baseline constant 'with its assertions' meaning unchanged'. The allowlist rewrite also removed the old wo-gh-9 and `src/index.js` and `src/page.js` entries, so the assertion is no weaker. The S10 test passes against the new baseline.

The test evidence is real and mapped. The tests map to scenarios S7, S8/R4 and S10 by name. The committed logs are `evidence/web-render-finish/behavior-tests.log`, `suite.log`, `bundle-build.log`, `frozen-product.log` and `reproducibility.log`. Before and after beats and browser pass logs exist under `evidence/web-render-finish/before/` and `after/`.

`reproducibility.log` records two consecutive full Blender 4.5.15 builds with the same GLB SHA256 (`1b9bab70…`) and the same module SHA256. It states the committed `src/patch-one-glb.js` equals the export byte for byte. The GLB is 798,088 bytes against the 819,200 budget, down from 798,092, and the size is stated.
I did not open the before and after PNGs. Whether both finish problems are closed in the page rendering is reviewer-design's call and is not covered by these tests.

Minor: the capture script `scripts/capture-take-apart.mjs` gained a `CAPTURE_DIR` option and writes the pass log twice. S10 allows this because the before and after capture requires it, and the default output paths are unchanged.
